gen-gf-gveret-levin-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern and crisp, its curve tips held well apart and its mean line set high. And Gveret Levin, the handwritten heading above it, brings a rope-like friendliness that keeps a longer page from feeling stiff.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-amulya: Relaxed lettering, stretched out and plainly hand-drawn, takes the heading spot in Hachi Maru Pop. Amulya below it keeps its curves generously open, so the two sit together like a doodle beside a tidy note.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-neco: Inviting and loose, Hachi Maru Pop spaces its hand-drawn letters out with an e that opens to the right. Neco follows with a measured swell from hairline to stem, and its letters never pinch shut, so a longer stretch stays dignified.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-plein:
Stretched-out, hand-drawn letter spacing defines Hachi Maru Pop.

It does loose, friendly display work best, while Plein does its job in the quieter role, giving each round letter a clear channel in and keeping a plain sans body reliable.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-recia: Marker-drawn plainness, with wide spacing and a right-facing e, marks Hachi Maru Pop. And Recia, a classic serif with medium contrast and openings that stay generous, steps in underneath to add a sharper, more authoritative voice.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-spline-sans: Loose, hand-drawn and happily spaced out, that is Hachi Maru Pop. Spline Sans backs it with wide gaps at the curve ends and strokes of identical weight, which makes the pair's friendliness feel organized.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-synonym: Relaxed is the first impression from Hachi Maru Pop, with its stretched-out spacing and hand-drawn charm. But Synonym, a plain sans with constant ink and open curves, gives the pair a dependable footing.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-outfit: Loose, spaced-out handwriting leads, with Hachi Maru Pop showing an e that opens clearly to the right. And Outfit, a sans cut like bent cable with curves that finish before they close, tidies the page up beneath it.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-plus-jakarta-sans: Hachi Maru Pop brings stretched-out, hand-drawn letters and an e that opens to the right. Plus Jakarta Sans sits underneath in monoline sans-serif, its curve endings kept apart, so the loose and the precise share the page.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-sora:
Inviting and relaxed, Hachi Maru Pop looks hand-drawn.

Sora's geometric precision, with no pressure swell at the curve turns and a c and s kept widely parted, is what makes the pair stand out.
